page: Microsoft Azure DC64eds_v6 is an x86_64 virtual machine instance running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system provides 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor alongside 256.0 GB of system memory, establishing a standard general-purpose ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes 3780 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage and provides support for Premium Storage block devices. It contains no discrete GPU hardware accelerators and is provisioned without complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The physical configuration targets balanced compute density accompanied by substantial high-speed temporary storage. Deploying 3780 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD eliminates network transfer overhead for transactional logs, caching layers, and scratch datasets. In qualitative cost-efficiency terms, bundling extensive local solid-state capacity reduces reliance on external premium storage volumes for ephemeral workloads, optimizing expenditure for IOPS-sensitive applications that can leverage host-local disk.

Given the balanced allocation of processing cores and memory combined with high-capacity local NVMe storage, the DC64eds_v6 is structurally tailored for relational databases, big data extract-transform-load (ETL) processing, continuous integration build clusters, and high-concurrency web application serving.
description: Microsoft Azure DC64eds_v6 is an x86_64 enterprise virtual server built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and 256.0 GB of system memory. It provides a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, complemented by an integrated 3780 GB local NVMe SSD array for high-speed scratch and caching needs, alongside support for Premium Storage volumes. Lacking discrete graphics acceleration, the instance concentrates entirely on high-capacity general compute and direct NVMe storage throughput. In qualitative terms, the inclusion of extensive onboard NVMe drives delivers cost-efficient input-output capability by minimizing dependence on network-attached storage for ephemeral processing data. This hardware architecture makes the DC64eds_v6 well fitted for demanding enterprise databases, large-scale ETL pipelines, batch data processing, distributed continuous integration jobs, and throughput-intensive web application tiers requiring predictable local performance.
